title: Support Vector Machines Directly Minimise KL Divergence
abstract: arXiv:2611.05557v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Support vector machines (SVMs) are fundamentally grounded in geometric margin maximisation and currently lack a mainstream probabilistic interpretation. This keeps them theoretically isolated from probabilistic machine learning models that are naturally comparable and combinable. In this paper, we bridge this gap by proving that the dual objectives of both support vector classification and support vector regression are exact, constrained Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence minimisation tasks between two Gaussian measures. We further show that this same divergence formulation recovers the exact objective function for kernel ridge regression when domain constraints are removed and $L^2$ regularisation is applied. translated_title: 支持向量机直接最小化KL散度
translated_abstract: 支持向量机（SVM）从根本上建立在几何间隔最大化之上，目前缺乏主流的概率解释。这使其在理论上与那些天然可比较、可组合的概率机器学习模型相互隔离。在本文中，我们通过证明支持向量分类和支持向量回归的对偶目标函数都是两个高斯测度之间精确的、带约束的Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度最小化任务，来弥合这一差距。我们进一步证明，当去除定义域约束并施加 $L^2$ 正则化时，同样的散度形式可以恢复核岭回归的精确目标函数。通过证明SVM的对偶问题直接最小化相对熵，我们的结果为标准核机器提供了一个统一的信息论模型，并为在概率框架下统一更广泛的基于核的算法奠定了基础。
tldr: 本文证明支持向量分类与回归的对偶目标等价于两个高斯测度之间的带约束KL散度最小化，从而为标准核机器建立了统一的信息论解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the dual objectives of support vector classification and regression are exact constrained KL divergence minimisation between two Gaussian measures, establishing a unified information-theoretic interpretation for standard kernel machines.
